description:
### Overall Layout
The figure represents 'Panel 3: Softmax attention', organized in a clean, balanced, top-to-bottom and left-to-right flow on a solid pure white background:
- **Top Left**: A header block identifying step number '3' and stage name 'Softmax attention', accompanied by a subtitle tag 'softmax over the keys'.
- **Upper Center**: Two 14×14 heatmaps placed side-by-side—matrix S on the left and matrix A on the right—joined by a central horizontal periwinkle-violet block arrow labelled 'softmax'. Both matrices are strictly sparse with crisp tile boundaries, lacking any smooth artificial gradients.
- **Middle Section**: Two discrete 1D bar charts positioned directly beneath their respective matrices, precisely aligned column-by-column across 14 discrete gene positions to depict row i.
- **Bottom Center**: Mathematical formulation defining row-wise softmax with per-gene temperature scaling.

---

### Component-by-Component Description

#### 1. Header (Top Left)
- **Step Badge**: A solid black circular badge containing a clean, white bold sans-serif numeral '**3**'.
- **Panel Title**: Immediately to the right of the badge, crisp bold black text reads: **Softmax attention**.
- **Process Chip**: Directly below the title, a light warm-gray rounded pill tag containing dark charcoal sans-serif text: `softmax over the keys`. The pill features a distinct vertical violet accent bar along its left edge.

---

#### 2. Matrix Heatmaps (Upper Section)

##### Left Matrix: Matrix S (Raw CLR Scores)
- **Title**: A clean black sans-serif letter **S** centered directly above the matrix.
- **Grid Structure**: A 14×14 square grid of uniformly sized tiles separated by hairline white grid lines. Exactly 14 diagonal self-cells (cells (k, k) from (1, 1) straight to (14, 14)) are uniform, solid neutral light-grey squares forming an uninterrupted, perfectly straight diagonal line.
- **Heatmap Sparsity & Color Distribution (Orange scale: 0 = near-white/pale cream, 9 = darkest saturated terracotta)**:
  - The matrix is strictly sparse; the vast majority of cells are pale cream (near-white). There are no horizontal, vertical, or regional gradients, and no printed numeric digits inside cells.
  - Highly colored cells strictly form two modular clusters and three isolated off-diagonal pairs:
    1. **Central cluster (genes 4–9)**: dense block of medium-to-dark terracotta tiles around the diagonal spanning rows 4–9 and columns 4–9.
    2. **Lower-right cluster (genes 10–13)**: dense block of medium-to-dark terracotta tiles spanning rows 10–13 and columns 10–13.
    3. **Isolated dark cells**: row 1 col 12, row 3 col 14, and row 14 col 3.
- **Highlight Bands & Crosshair**:
  - **Row i (Query Gene)**: A flat, translucent soft sky-blue horizontal band covering **row 4**, with a bold blue italic label **i** to its left.
  - **Column j (Key Gene)**: A flat, translucent dusty-rose/pink vertical band covering **column 5**, with a bold magenta italic label **j** centered directly above column 5.
  - **Intersection (i, j)**: The crossing cell is strictly at **row 4, column 5** (immediately to the right of diagonal cell (4, 4)), framed with a sharp, high-contrast dark charcoal square outline. The diagonal self-cell (4, 4) remains plain light grey to its left.

##### Central Flow Arrow
- Positioned horizontally between matrix S and matrix A.
- A flat periwinkle-violet horizontal block arrow pointing from left to right.
- Centered directly above the arrow is crisp violet sans-serif text: **softmax**.

##### Right Matrix: Matrix A (Attention Weights)
- **Title**: A clean black sans-serif letter **A** centered directly above the matrix.
- **Grid Structure**: An identical 14×14 square grid matching matrix S. Exactly 14 diagonal self-cells (cells (k, k) from (1, 1) straight to (14, 14)) are solid neutral light-grey squares forming a straight, uninterrupted diagonal line.
- **Heatmap Sparsity & Color Distribution (Violet scale: 0 = near-white/pale lavender, 9 = darkest royal violet)**:
  - Strictly sparse: the vast majority of cells are near-white/pale lavender without any smooth gradient.
  - Saturated violet cells strictly reflect the post-softmax weights of top CLR entries, mirroring the modular cluster locations (genes 4–9 and 10–13, plus isolated connections).
- **Highlight Bands & Crosshair**:
  - Translucent soft sky-blue horizontal band covering **row 4**, with a bold blue italic label **i** to its left.
  - Translucent dusty-rose/pink vertical band covering **column 5**, with a bold magenta italic label **j** centered directly above column 5.
  - Crossing cell at **row 4, column 5** is framed with a solid dark charcoal square outline, leaving diagonal cell (4, 4) in plain light grey immediately to its left.

---

#### 3. Row-wise Bar Charts (Middle Section)

Aligned directly beneath each matrix, strictly matching the horizontal column positions of the 14 genes:

##### Left Bar Strip: Row i of Matrix S
- **Base Axis**: A thin medium-gray horizontal line spanning columns 1 through 14.
- **Column Guide**: The dusty-rose translucent vertical band continues downward seamlessly through **column 5**.
- **Bars & Coloring**:
  - Depicts row 4 CLR scores. Columns 1, 2, 3, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 and diagonal column 4 have no bars (flat at zero baseline).
  - Terracotta orange bars are present only at active columns 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.
  - The bar at **column 5** is the tallest (dark saturated terracotta), directly aligned within the pink guide band, accompanied by a magenta text callout immediately to its right: **S_{ij} = 2.8**.
- **Subtitles Below Axis**:
  - Line 1: Bold black text: **row i of S**.
  - Line 2: Dark gray explanatory note: `dark: top 5 kept (real: 50)`.

##### Right Bar Strip: Row i of Matrix A
- **Base Axis**: A thin medium-gray horizontal line spanning columns 1 through 14.
- **Column Guide**: The dusty-rose translucent vertical band continues downward seamlessly through **column 5**.
- **Bars & Coloring**:
  - Exactly one dominant, tall bar at **column 5** filled with deep saturated royal violet, directly aligned within the pink guide band, accompanied by a magenta text callout immediately to its right: **A_{ij} = 0.64**.
  - Very low, tiny violet bars at remaining active top neighbors (columns 6, 7, 8, 9); all other columns are flat at zero.
- **Subtitles Below Axis**:
  - Line 1: Bold black text: **row i of A**.
  - Line 2: Dark gray explanatory note: `sums to 1`.

---

#### 4. Mathematical Formulation (Bottom Section)
Centered horizontally beneath the bar charts:
- **Equation**: A_i = softmax(S_i / tau_i)
- **Parameter Note**: Located directly below the formula in clean dark gray text: `tau_i set per gene so that k_eff = 3 (real: 10)`

---

### Styling and Aesthetics
- Solid pure white background with no drop shadows or decorative borders.
- Crisp hairline boundaries between heatmap cells, with clean flat color blocks.
- High-contrast typography: bold modern sans-serif for labels, italic serif for mathematical symbols (i, j, S, A, tau).

critic_suggestions: Fix axis ticks and labels in the Matrix S bar strip: The horizontal axis currently displays '1 2 3 4 5 5 6 8 9 10 11 12 13 14', featuring a duplicated '5' and omitting '7'. Correct this to a strict, uniformly spaced sequence from 1 through 14.

Restore missing bar in Row i of S: The bar strip currently shows only 4 bars (at columns 5, 6, 8, 9) despite the note stating 'top 5 kept' and row 4 having 5 active orange cells (columns 5, 6, 7, 8, 9). Add the 5th bar at column 7.

Eliminate background tint and artifacts in heatmaps: Matrix A has faint lavender wash across almost all inactive cells, and Matrix S exhibits stray pale patches in the lower-left quadrant. Enforce true sparsity where all inactive cells outside the modular blocks (genes 4–9, genes 10–13) and specified isolated cells (row 1 col 12, row 3 col 14, row 14 col 3) are crisp near-white.
Ensure strict vertical alignment: The bars in both lower bar strips must align perfectly under the corresponding columns 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 of the 14×14 grid above.

user_feedback: The matrices are wrong: S and A must NOT be smooth gradients. Both are sparse: the vast majority of cells are near-white (S) or near-white lavender (A); only the cells listed with levels 3-9 in the digit grids I gave earlier are coloured, forming a dark chain block on genes 4-9 around the diagonal and a block on genes 10-13 at lower right, plus a few isolated dark cells at the top right and bottom left (row 3 column 14, row 1 column 12, row 14 column 3). No horizontal or vertical gradient. Do not print digits in cells. Bars: S row 4 has bars at columns 4-9 only (tallest at column 5, S_ij = 2.8); A row 4 has one dominant bar at column 5 (A_ij = 0.64) and tiny bars at columns 4, 6, 7, 8.
